text: The brighter the red, the worse the problem. Pale green means all is well. The rest of the map is dimmed.
Work has started, but there aren't enough hands.
People or carts are standing idle here.
Green fields are on schedule. Yellow fields are behind. Red means time is running out and the harvest is at risk.
Pale color means fertile soil. The brighter the color, the more depleted the soil.
A red storehouse is overflowing. Empty storehouses stay uncolored. Stock levels are shown in the office.
Green means the family is getting by. Red means low satisfaction. The household window shows why: hunger, fatigue, crowding, or illness.
Green ground is suitable for building. Red ground is blocked by a slope, water, a road, or another site. A red road is damaged.
Old and dead trees are highlighted. A fallen trunk icon marks a blocked route.
